raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute side length of the square domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a square with 64 elements per side, but gives no physical side length or length unit. These alternatives represent uniform changes of scale with relative geometry and filter lengths preserved.",
      "readings": [
        "Side length L = 1 in nondimensional units; element side length h = 1/64.",
        "Side length L = 64 in consistent length units; element side length h = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 4.1 describe a two-dimensional problem without specifying the thickness used to assemble stiffness and interpret resultant forces.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen length units.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.01L.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1L."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "fixed-support configuration for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 permits 1–4 fixed point or segment constraints at corners and edge midpoints. Neither the Sec. 5 prose nor the Fig. 3 caption identifies this row's count, locations, or segment endpoints. Coordinates below use the square [0,L] by [0,L].",
      "readings": [
        "One fixed segment covering the complete left edge.",
        "One fixed segment covering the lower half of the left edge.",
        "Two fixed points at the bottom-left and top-left corners.",
        "Two fixed points at the left-edge and bottom-edge midpoints.",
        "Three fixed points at the bottom-left, top-left, and bottom-right corners.",
        "Four fixed points, one at each corner."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "single external load for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 restricts the load to a domain edge, and Eq. (25) names its coordinates, but no coordinates for this row appear in the prose or Fig. 3 caption.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint: (L, L/2).",
        "Right edge at quarter height: (L, L/4).",
        "Top edge at one-third width: (L/3, L).",
        "Bottom-edge midpoint: (L/2, 0)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial footprint and nodal assembly of the external load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says a single load is applied 'along the edge'; Eq. (25) supplies coordinate fields but does not specify a concentrated nodal force, interpolation of an off-node force, or a distributed footprint.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated unit resultant at the nearest boundary node.",
        "Unit resultant split between adjacent boundary nodes using linear interpolation at the specified coordinate.",
        "Uniform traction over a boundary segment of length L/8 centered at the specified coordinate, normalized to a unit resultant."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "unit external force for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 states that direction is sampled randomly, but neither the row's direction nor its Fx and Fy values from Eq. (25) are reported.",
      "readings": [
        "(Fx, Fy) = (0, -1).",
        "(Fx, Fy) = (1, 0).",
        "(Fx, Fy) = (1/sqrt(2), -1/sqrt(2))."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "prescribed volume fraction for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 gives only the sampling range 0.3–0.5. The row-specific target is absent from Sec. 5 and the Fig. 3 caption.",
      "readings": [
        "f = 0.30.",
        "f = 0.40.",
        "f = 0.50."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "non-design elements and protected attachment regions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 4.1 do not explicitly identify passive masks or say whether elements adjoining loads and supports must remain solid.",
      "readings": [
        "All 4096 elements are designable; no passive regions.",
        "Elements incident on load or fixed-support nodes are held solid; remaining elements are designable.",
        "Elements incident on load or fixed-support nodes, plus their immediate neighboring elements, are held solid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) introduces E0, but no numerical value is supplied. The alternatives hold Poisson's ratio and Emin/E0 fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 in nondimensional units.",
        "E0 = 70 GPa.",
        "E0 = 210 GPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional elastic analyses in Secs. 2 and 4.1 have no specified Poisson's ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.",
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.30.",
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.45."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional elastic constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies two dimensions without identifying plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "minimum stiffness Emin",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) includes a minimum Young's modulus to regularize void elements, but its value or ratio to E0 is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin/E0 = 1e-3.",
        "Emin/E0 = 1e-6.",
        "Emin/E0 = 1e-9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "minimum design density rho_min",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (9) introduces rho_min without a value. The general bounds in Eq. (6) do not determine this additional numerical floor.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_min = 0.",
        "rho_min = 0.001.",
        "rho_min = 0.01."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter formulation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the SIMP procedure in Sec. 2 nor dataset generation in Sec. 4.1 specifies whether sensitivities or densities are filtered.",
      "readings": [
        "No filter.",
        "Element-neighborhood sensitivity filter.",
        "Element-neighborhood density filter."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter radius, if filtering is used",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 4.1 provide no filter length scale. Here h = L/64 is the stated square-element side length.",
      "readings": [
        "Filter radius r = 1.5h.",
        "Filter radius r = 2h.",
        "Filter radius r = 3h."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter kernel and treatment of domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If a neighborhood filter is used, Secs. 2 and 4.1 give neither its weights nor its normalization at square boundaries.",
      "readings": [
        "Conical weights max(0, r-distance), truncated to existing elements and renormalized.",
        "Uniform weights inside radius r, truncated to existing elements and renormalized.",
        "Conical weights with zero-density exterior padding included in the normalization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density projection during optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 mentions final thresholding but does not specify whether a smooth projection is also used during optimization, or its parameters and schedule.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection during optimization.",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold 0.5 and sharpness beta = 1 throughout.",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold 0.5, beta = 2 for the first 50 updates and beta = 8 for the remaining 50."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial SIMP density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies full-material FEA for conditioning fields, but does not explicitly identify the density field used to initialize the 100-step SIMP optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density equal to f.",
        "Uniform initial density equal to 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "multiplicative density-update parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (10) leaves m and eta unvalued. Eta affects the finite 100-update trajectory; a constant global m can be absorbed into an exactly solved volume multiplier.",
      "readings": [
        "m = 1 and eta = 0.25.",
        "m = 1 and eta = 0.5.",
        "m = 1 and eta = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite-element interpolation and integration on the stated square grid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.2 determine a uniform 64 by 64 square-element grid, but not element interpolation order or quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2 by 2 Gauss integration.",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with stabilized one-point integration.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3 by 3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "equilibrium linear solver and numerical accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (4) specifies equilibrium, but Secs. 2 and 4.1 do not identify the numerical solver or its accuracy. This limits exact numerical reproduction.",
      "readings": [
        "Double-precision sparse direct factorization.",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-8.",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-4."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "numerical solution of the volume multiplier lambda",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. (10)–(11) require lambda to enforce the volume constraint, but give no numerical root-finding accuracy.",
      "readings": [
        "Bisection until absolute volume-fraction residual is below 1e-10.",
        "Bisection until absolute volume-fraction residual is below 1e-6.",
        "Bisection until absolute volume-fraction residual is below 1e-4."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "conversion of optimized densities into the binary SIMP design",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 requires thresholding and Sec. 4.1 stores a binary topology map, but neither specifies the cutoff, which density field is thresholded, or whether binarization preserves the prescribed volume.",
      "readings": [
        "Set solid where final physical density is at least 0.5.",
        "Set solid where final physical density is at least 0.3.",
        "Set solid where the final unfiltered design variable is at least 0.5.",
        "Retain the round(4096f) elements with highest final physical densities, with deterministic index ordering for ties."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
